user_saw: An embedded session could record a requested `max` as `high`, and Chat Completions could send `xhigh` even when the custom backend declared native `max`.
summary: The fix makes the shared session clamp and request serialization honor declared reasoning tiers while preserving API-specific defaults.
reasoning: The July 1 snapshot already accepted `supportedReasoningEfforts` in model configuration, required a separate mapping to retain `max` in embedded sessions, and rewrote any surviving `max` to `xhigh` in Chat Completions. The September 4 commit added a Responses-only bypass and left both affected paths untouched. The available history ends at the shallow boundary, so I could neither identify the introducing commit nor verify that the affected behavior ever worked.
